newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: RODAMCO NINE MONTH NET SOARS.
newsitem.headline: RODAMCO NINE MONTH NET SOARS.

text.p: Property investment fund Rodamco NV said on Tuesday it had a net result of 563 million guilders in the first nine months of 1996/97, a 148 percent rise compared to the same period last year.
Net profit per share amounted to 0.70 guilders in the third quarter of the financial year, up eight percent on the average earnings per share in the firs two quarters (0.65 guilders).
Rodamco said its improved nine-month result was due primarily to acquisitions and also to an upturn in the property market.

"The favourable development...is a direct consequence of substantial purchases effected in the last few months, which have pushed up net rental income, as well as a gradual recovery of the property markets and, in particular, distinctly positive currency results," it said.
The increase in third quarter earnings per share versus the two previous quarters was attributed to sizeable recent investments, a partial share buy-back and currency effects.
Rodamco said the expansion of its portfolio, further improvement of the quality of existing investments and the gradual recovery of most markets had pushed up net rental income in all countries.
